---
name: Work item
about: Define a bounded change before implementation
---

## Problem and expected behavior

Describe the concrete user/developer problem and desired result. Include reproduction steps for bugs; never paste secrets or access tokens.

## Scope

What changes are included? Note explicit exclusions and any client/API/storage compatibility constraints.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Observable behavior or deliverable is defined.
- [ ] Relevant security, authorization and data integrity requirements are covered.

## Validation plan

List focused checks, regression cases and necessary integration evidence. Identify migrations, rollout/rollback considerations or unavailable dependencies when relevant.

## Workflow

Sol implements on an isolated branch; Astra independently reviews the latest head. Link the resulting PR here. Intake and deployment are manual; this template does not dispatch agents or provision services.
